items.title: Call to Order - 9:00 a.m.
notes: Mayor Guthrie called the meeting to order. (9:03 a.m.)

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and General Nature Thereof
Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget - 2023-408
notes:
Mayor Guthrie provided opening remarks. Scott Stewart, Chief Administrative Officer introduced Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Report. Colleen Clack-Bush, Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, Public Services presented information on Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Report. Jayne Holmes, Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, Infrastructure, Development and Enterprise Services continued the presentation on Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Report. Trevor Lee, Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, Corporate Services also presented on Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Report.

Council recessed (10:17 a.m.)
Council reconvened (10:32 a.m.)

Tara Baker, General Manager, Finance/City Treasurer continued the presentation on Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Report.

Council recessed (11:15 a.m.)
Council reconvened (11:20 a.m.)

City Council continued its discussion regarding Guelph's 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Report.

Council Recessed (12:26 p.m.)
Council Reconvened (1:02 p.m.)

attachments.name: Attachment-2 Identified investments deferred, delayed or removed from the budget (2024-2027).pdf

motions.text: That Council request City of Guelph staff to review the multi-year budget with a request to reduce the overall 2024 Budget by 2% and to provide to Council a memo outlining the further reductions of either operating or capital to achieve these reductions for further Council consideration prior to the November 15th public delegation night. And that Council respectfully requests all outside local boards and services to also consider reducing their overall 2024 operating budgets by 2% and to provide a memo to City Council for further consideration.

And that Council respectfully requests all outside local boards and services to also consider reducing their overall 2024 operating budgets by 2% and to provide a memo to City Council for further consideration.
motions.post_html:
The motion was withdrawn by the mover and seconder.

Council recessed (3:28 p.m.)
Council reconvened (3:38 p.m.)

motions.text: That Council direct staff to schedule a budget workshop on November 22 at 6pm to consider further options for reductions within the multi-year budget to inform possible budget amendments on November 29.

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned. (3:42 p.m.)
